brief_zh: 今日共5則高危（其他高危2則、接管1則），無在野利用，優先看 Teledyne FLIR 路徑遍歷漏洞。

items.title_zh: Fortinet 檔案寫入在野利用
items.summary_zh: 未授權攻擊者可透過惡意請求寫入任意檔案。
items.desc_en: An improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory ('path traversal') vulnerability in Fortinet FortiMail 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiMail 7.6.0 through 7.6.6, FortiMail 7.4.0 through 7.4.8, FortiMail 7.2.0 through 7.2.9 may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

items.title_zh: Cisco SD-WAN 認證繞過在野利用
items.summary_zh: 攻擊者可繞過 API 認證並取得管理員權限。
items.desc_en:
Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager API Authentication Bypass Vulnerability

A vulnerability in the API session-based authentication management of Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user.

items.title_zh: Teledyne FLIR 路徑遍歷漏洞
items.summary_zh: 攻擊者可透過路徑遍歷讀取機器人配置參數。
items.fix_hint: 升級 Aware2 至安全版本
items.desc_en: Unvalidated pathnames in the web interface in Teledyne FLIR Aware2 versions through 6.9.0.2 (PackBot) and 1.7.9 (FirstLook) allows remote unauthenticated attackers to read configuration and security parameters on Teledyne FLIR PackBot and FirstLook robots running this software via path traversal.

items.title_zh: Fortra BoKS 密碼預測漏洞
items.summary_zh: 可預測的偽隨機序列導致服務帳號密碼可被破解。
items.desc_en: In deployments using BoKS keytab management, affected versions of boks_keytabmd generate Active Directory service-account passwords from a predictable pseudo-random sequence seeded with the current Unix timestamp. An attacker who knows the service principal and can estimate the password-change time can reproduce a limited candidate set and verify candidates offline.

items.title_zh: Foreman 沙箱繞過 RCE 漏洞
items.summary_zh: 低權限用戶可繞過沙箱在伺服器執行任意指令。
items.fix_hint: 更新 Foreman 及其模板引擎
items.desc_en: A flaw was found in Foreman. An authenticated attacker with low-level permissions can achieve remote code execution (RCE) by bypassing the safemode sandbox within the templating engine. Due to improper handling of delegated methods, an attacker can append unauthorized functions to the allowed execution list, enabling them to run arbitrary commands on the hosting server.
